items.stemEn: She cleaned the table with a wet ____.
Put a ____ under the cup so the table stays dry.
items.stemZh: 在杯子下面放個茶碟，桌子才不會濕。

items.passageEn: Living with my brother is not always easy. He is quite careless: he leaves his rubbish everywhere and never washes the kettle. Last week, he used my new sponge to clean his bike! Then he had the gall to say it was my fault for leaving it in the bathroom. He also forgets to buy toothpaste. But he has good points too. Every night, he puts a glass of water on my bedside table, and in winter he knits warm hats for us both.
items.passageZh: 和我的兄弟一起住不見得輕鬆。他相當粗心：垃圾到處亂丟，也從不洗水壺。上星期，他竟然用我的新海綿洗他的腳踏車！接著還好意思說，是我自己把海綿放在浴室裡的錯。他也老是忘了買牙膏。不過他也有優點：每天晚上，他都會在我的床頭櫃上放一杯水，冬天還會幫我們兩個織保暖的帽子。

questions.questionZh: 作者的兄弟用作者的新海綿做什麼？
